title: Week 6 MFPI analysis: Tupelo High School leads the statewide rankings
dek: What moved in the Week 6 Mississippi Football Power Index, computed from verified results through Oct 6.
author: MFPI automated analysis

sources.label: MHSAA official score center (schedules and scores)
Statewide media rankings used for the Media Rank inputs

limitations: Generated from the published snapshot; no games after the cutoff are included.
Media Rank and Media Strength of Schedule contribute 20% of every rating; MFPI's own score-based model contributes 80%.
No player, injury, coaching or game-narrative information is used or implied.

sections.heading: The top of the statewide rankings
paragraphs: [[tupelo]] (6-0) is No. 1 for the 6th straight published week. MFPI rating: increased 1.4 points to 97.1. In the latest window it beat Hartfield Academy (not in the MHSAA ranking) 49-7 on the road on Oct 2.
No. 2 [[diberville]] (6-0, 7A): ranking unchanged at No. 2; rating increased 1.0 points to 95.6. It beat [[west-harrison]] (currently No. 45) 45-7 at home on Oct 1.
No. 3 [[warren-central]] (5-0, 6A): ranking unchanged at No. 3; rating increased 0.1 points to 92.8. It had no verified result in this window.
No. 4 [[brandon]] (5-1, 7A): ranking up 4 spots to No. 4 (from No. 8); rating increased 2.5 points to 91.7. It beat [[northwest-rankin]] (currently No. 42) 34-14 at home on Oct 2.
No. 5 [[starkville]] (4-1, 7A): ranking down 1 spot to No. 5 (from No. 4); rating decreased 0.1 points to 91.2. It had no verified result in this window.

sections.heading: Classification leaders
paragraphs: Class ranks are the statewide order filtered to one classification; MFPI never recalculates a separate class rating.

sections.heading: Results that raised ratings most
paragraphs: The largest rating increases among teams with a verified result in this window. A rating can also move without a game, because every opponent's rating is re-solved each week.
[[newton-county]] (+12.1 to 60.4, now No. 87) beat [[northeast-lauderdale]] (currently No. 168) 42-7 at home on Oct 2.
[[kemper-county]] (+11.9 to 69.5, now No. 53) beat [[east-webster]] (currently No. 63) 45-20 at home on Oct 2.
[[morton]] (+11.0 to 80.0, now No. 29) beat [[richland]] (currently No. 93) 49-20 on the road on Oct 2.
[[independence]] (+9.5 to 53.7, now No. 101) beat [[holly-springs]] (currently No. 177) 42-6 on the road on Oct 1.
[[strayhorn]] (+8.5 to 24.1, now No. 187) beat [[coffeeville]] (currently No. 194) 35-8 at home on Oct 1.
The full list of movers is in the [[risers-and-fallers:2026-week-06-risers-and-fallers]] analysis.

sections.heading: Schedule strength
paragraphs: MFPI strength of schedule is the average current rating of every completed opponent, expressed as a statewide percentile (100 is the strongest schedule in this week's field, not a perfect grade). The five strongest schedules: [[west-point]] (0-5, SOS percentile 100.0); [[oxford]] (5-1, SOS percentile 99.6); [[west-harrison]] (2-4, SOS percentile 99.1); [[madison-central]] (2-4, SOS percentile 98.7); [[brandon]] (5-1, SOS percentile 98.2).

Teams that have played furthest above their own classification (average class steps up, games up in class): [[okolona]] (1A, +2.20, 5 up); [[charleston]] (2A, +2.00, 5 up); [[byers]] (1A, +2.00, 4 up); [[lumberton]] (1A, +1.80, 5 up); [[poplarville]] (4A, +1.67, 5 up).

sections.heading: Data notes and limitations
paragraphs: Snapshot generated October 6, 2026 at 11:22 AM Central with a cutoff of October 6 at 11:00 AM Central, formula MFPI-3.2.
663 of 675 game listings due by the cutoff had verified scores (98.2%); the rest count as unavailable, never as losses or 0-0 results.
Opponent ranks in this article are the opponent's rank in this snapshot, not its rank on the day the game was played, unless a sentence says otherwise.
